title: Midst
subtitle: A surreal space-western told with swagger, precision, and a refusal to stay conventional.
description: A reality-bending sci-fantasy audio drama in which three narrators guide the listener through a dangerous cosmos full of bad decisions, power structures, and gorgeous nonsense.

length.label: Critical Role announced season 3 as the final season of the main series.

archiveTake: A good escalation route once the listener wants bigger conceptual play without losing strong character propulsion.

similarReasons.midnight-burger: A warmer cosmic branch if the big ideas mattered as much as the affection.
similarReasons.ars-paradoxica: Keeps the conceptual ambition high while making the science spine more explicit.
similarReasons.the-program-audio-series: A colder, more systems-minded branch for listeners who want the worldview to stay central.
similarReasons.the-waystation: An exploratory route if the strange setting and sense of scale mattered more than the chaos.
